description.text:
McDonald's Original Minimum★Pack, sold only at McDonald's in Japan from 26 January to 24 February 2002, for 180 yen to anyone who bought a meal there, as many as they liked. Each six-card pack is a ready-made hand for the Minimum rules: three Basic Pokémon, one of them cosmos holo, and a Basic Energy of each one's type, the holo Pokémon's Energy holo too. The contents are fixed, so there are six packs, one for each holo Pokémon: Chikorita, Charmander, Squirtle, Pikachu, Slowpoke and Larvitar. A sheet of paper damage counters and a coin came on top.

The Minimum rules have no deck, discard pile or Prize cards: each player starts with all six cards in hand and puts every Pokémon into play, attaches one Energy a turn, and takes back into their hand any Energy that would be discarded. Whoever Knocks Out all the other's Pokémon wins. The packs sold alongside that winter's Happy Meals, which each came with a one-card pack of a P promo. On Bulbasaur's card, its two yellow vines make the McDonald's M against a red background.
